race.comment: MONEY HONEY (8) worked over to lead from a wide gate at Kyneton last start, and was only claimed late. She is a talented filly, and with a big swing in her draw this time, she can take them all the way. HANDSOME DEVIL (11) is a lightly tried 7YO gelding who makes his debut from the Luke Williams stable, who presented him to finish a close runner-up at a recent Warrnambool jump-out. He must be worth preserving with, so keep an eye on the markets. BECAUSEYOU'RE MINE (4) was close up when resuming, and then put in a poor run off a tough trip last time out at Ballarat just over 3 weeks ago. He is worth another chance. ABBY'S CROSSWORD (7) ended her last season at the end of March with an overdue win. She has a nice gate for her return, and having Linda Meech in the saddle is a positive lead. Each way value.
